description:
¿Por qué nadie puede abrir la puerta de un avión en pleno vuelo? Porque el aire a presión de la cabina la aprieta contra su marco con la fuerza de varios autos.
Y esa misma fuerza, en 2024, le arrancó a un avión un panel al que le faltaban sus cuatro pernos. ✈️
Envíaselo a ese amigo que siempre pide el asiento junto a la salida de emergencia.
wardrobe: Scene 3 passengers (four figures, clearly different people; recolour slots fig_skin / fig_shirt / fig_pants / fig_boots): P1 #D99E7A / #2973CC / #2E3347 / #59331A (the default outfit); P2 #8D5A3B / #C8553D terracotta / #3B4A3A olive / #2A2A2A; P3 #F0C8A8 / #E8B931 mustard / #5A5F6B slate / #6B4A2B; P4 #B07A55 / #3E8E6E green / #22252E / #4A2E1C.
Scene 5: two or three seated passengers further along the row reuse P2-P4; the two seats beside the panel stay empty (true to the event).
The design lens may shift any slot value to clear the composition gate, keeping the four combinations distinct.

scenes.name: hook
scenes.narration: ¿Por qué nadie puede abrir la puerta de un avión en pleno vuelo? Parece que va cerrada con llave. Pero no hay ninguna llave.
scenes.what_changes: Contrast, two actors on one stage: two identical fuselage sections side by side, one on the ground (bright apron light in its windows), one in flight (dark-blue sky in its windows). The same hand grips the door handle of each: the ground door swings open, the flight door does not move; tag ¿LLAVE? appears, then takes a red X.
scenes.transformation: dos puertas cerradas → la del suelo se abre, la del vuelo no se mueve
scenes.camera: órbita baja desde la puerta en tierra hasta la puerta en vuelo

elements.name: airplane door in a fuselage section
elements.route: build: plug door, frame and curved fuselage section with oval windows (geometric); exterior and cabin context from the airliner class (open job `airliner`; library candidates: Sketchfab CC0 Boeing 737-200 by mgg8 e3224d0a, CC-BY Airbus A320 by Kyaie 757aa190)
elements.risk: medium: a door in a curved wall must read as an AIRPLANE door; the oval windows are the context cue

scenes.name: tapon
scenes.narration: La puerta es más grande que su hueco. Para salir, primero tiene que moverse hacia adentro, como un tapón.
scenes.what_changes: Push-through into a top-down cutaway of the door in its frame: the door is wider than the opening, its edge stops overlap the frame stops (both light in the accent); the door slides inward, turns, and only then swings out through the hole.
scenes.transformation: puerta encajada en el marco → se mete hacia adentro, gira y recién sale
scenes.camera: empuje a través del fuselaje hasta una vista cenital del marco

elements.name: plug door in its frame (top-down cutaway)
elements.route: build, geometric: door slab with edge stops, frame with matching stops
elements.risk: medium: a top-down section can read as a plain hinge; the curved fuselage wall stays in frame as the cue

scenes.name: presion
scenes.narration: En vuelo, la cabina se llena de aire a presión, para que puedas respirar. Afuera, el aire es mucho más delgado.
scenes.what_changes: The fuselage section climbs into a dark sky; inside, warm accent air streams from the vents and packs the cabin around four seated passengers, while outside the sparse air thins out as the section rises.
scenes.transformation: cabina con aire normal → cabina repleta de aire y afuera aire cada vez más ralo
scenes.camera: travelling lateral a lo largo de la fila de asientos, saliendo por la ventana

elements.name: airplane cabin with seated passengers
elements.route: build: seat rows (geometric) + human-figure, sealed pose seated, four passengers with distinct wardrobes (staging notes); cabin wall from the door build
elements.risk: medium: rows of seats plus oval windows are the cabin cue; seated figure is sealed (85/80/72)

scenes.name: empuje
scenes.narration: Ese aire empuja la puerta hacia afuera, contra su marco, con la fuerza de varios autos encima.
scenes.what_changes: Escalation as movement (rung 3 applied: the door area could not be sourced, so no tonne figure is spoken or shown): the door is pressed outward into its stops by the accent air; beside it the push is made physical: cars drop one by one onto the door's outline laid flat, and the camera pulls back to take in the stack.
scenes.transformation: una puerta apretada por el aire → cinco autos apilados sobre ella, uno por uno
scenes.camera: retroceso y subida a medida que cae cada auto

scenes.name: giro
scenes.narration: Y cuando esa fuerza no está bien sujeta, gana. En 2024, a un avión se le soltó en pleno vuelo un panel tapón: le faltaban los cuatro pernos que lo trababan.
scenes.what_changes: The turn: wide exterior of the fuselage in the sky; a door-plug panel aft of the wing, with its four bolt points empty (red), creeps up off its stops and blows outward; the cabin air rushes after it (the empty-seat detail is not staged: only one source for it).
scenes.transformation: panel en su sitio sin pernos → sube, se suelta y sale volando
scenes.camera: seguimiento exterior a lo largo del fuselaje, de la cola hacia el panel

elements.name: airliner with a blown-out side panel
elements.route: airliner class: open job `airliner` (exterior) built under its brief by the production (asset-system (g)) or the CC0/CC-BY library candidates above; panel and bolt points are geometric
elements.risk: medium-high: the airliner exterior is an unsealed class; written fallbacks below

scenes.name: cierre
scenes.narration: Así que la puerta de un avión no la cierra una llave: la cierra el aire de adentro. Envíaselo a ese amigo que siempre pide el asiento junto a la salida de emergencia.
scenes.what_changes: Single reframe image: back inside, the door glows held in its frame by the packed accent air while the hand rests on the handle, doing nothing; pull-back to the whole section in the sky.
scenes.transformation: mano en la manilla → la puerta queda sellada solo por el aire, que brilla alrededor
scenes.camera: retroceso desde la manilla hasta la sección entera del fuselaje

sources: Plug-type passenger doors are larger than their opening; cabin pressure presses them into the frame, and opening needs an inward move first: TravelPulse 'Why an airplane door won't open in mid-flight'; Business Insider 2020 (same explanation); A320 door description (plug-type, opening upward, outward and forward). FLAGGED: confirm against a manufacturer or regulator text at the beat sheet.
Cabin pressurisation exists so occupants can breathe at cruise altitude: SKYbrary 'Aircraft Pressurisation Systems'.
Differential pressure: Boeing 737 MAX FCOM schedule, 7.45 psid at or below 28,000 ft, 7.80 psid from 28,000 to 37,000 ft, 8.35 psid above 37,000 ft (live search 2026-11-11). 7.45 psid = 51.4 kPa.

Door area about 0.8 m x 1.8 m = 1.44 m2 (FLAGGED: confirm in Boeing 737 ACAP 'Door clearances, forward main entry door' or Airbus A320 Aircraft Characteristics 'Forward passenger/crew doors'). Arithmetic: 51.4 kPa x 1.44 m2 = 74 kN = about 7.5 t-force (8.35 psid gives about 8.5 t). Narration says 'unas siete toneladas', the low end. If the area cannot be sourced, rung 3 below removes the number.
Five cars: 7.5 t / about 1.4-1.5 t per mid-size car = 5. FLAGGED: source one common sedan's kerb weight at the beat sheet.

Turn: Alaska Airlines flight 1282, 5 January 2024, Boeing 737-9: the left mid-exit door plug separated about six minutes after take-off from Portland; the four bolts that secure it were missing when the aircraft left the factory (NTSB final report, press release NR20250624, 24 June 2025; AvWeb and Airline Geeks coverage, July 2025). The two seats beside the plug were unoccupied (widely reported; FLAGGED to confirm in the NTSB report before staging empty seats).
simplifications: The door's stops are drawn larger than real for legibility.
Air under pressure is drawn as glowing accent air; real air is invisible.
The 'panel tapón' is a plug fitted where an optional emergency exit can go, not a passenger door; the narration calls it a panel, not a door.
